title: How to add >x< buttons to your website
description: >x< buttons let you embed >x< content on your website. Learn how to generate and add the HTML code to your site.

toc.title: What if I've already made my own >x< button? Can I still use it?

runs: Use the dropdown to select what type of content you would like to use. Then, copy the HTML code that pops up.
Paste that code in the appropriate area of your website's source code.
What if I've already made my own >x< button? Can I still use it?
Of course you can! However, it's a good idea to take a peek at our
guides to make sure you are complying with our trademark policy.
